links.outcome: Accuracy of claims in ungrounded GPT-4 Turbo vaccine persuasion dialogues, fact-checked by independent AI
links.effect: Of 15,559 AI-generated claims, median accuracy 100/100, mean 95.4/100; only 0.4% of claims were medically inaccurate.
links.quote: Fact-checking of all 15,559 AI-generated claims using an independent AI model with web search capability revealed high overall accuracy (median = 100/100, mean = 95.4/100 on a scale where 0 = completely inaccurate and 100 = completely accurate), with only 0.4% of claims being medically inaccurate.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-based persuasive dialogues to increase parental HPV vaccination intentions compared with an informational brochure

screen.reason: Randomized trial testing the efficacy of interactive LLM conversations (GPT-4 Turbo) versus a standard brochure or control LLM conversation on parents' HPV vaccine intentions; does not test a deployment guardrail or organizational implementation practice.
